blocks.en: Let the kernel $k:\Omega\times\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ be Hilbert-Schmidt. Then the integral operator $K\in\mathcal{L}(L^2(\Omega))$ defined by\[K(u)(\bm{x}):=\int_\Omega k(\bm{x},\bm{y})u(\bm{y})\,\mathrm{d}\bm{y}\]is compact.
blocks.zh: 设核 $k:\Omega\times\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ 为 Hilbert-Schmidt 的. 那么由下式定义的积分算子 $K\in\mathcal{L}(L^2(\Omega))$ 为紧算子:\[K(u)(\bm{x}):=\int_\Omega k(\bm{x},\bm{y})u(\bm{y})\,\mathrm{d}\bm{y}\]
blocks.label: thm:hilbert-schmidt-kernel-compactness
